title: Expected distribution
view: Shared hand base (visuals/distribution_bases/hand): skeleton of the right hand from the palm side, then the right hand from the palm side (thumb on the image right) and from the back (thumb on the image left); right hand.
teachingPoint: A median block in the forearm numbs the radial palm, the palm side of the thumb, index, middle and radial ring finger, and their nail beds.
claims: Skin: radial two thirds of the palm and the thenar eminence (palmar cutaneous branch, given off above the wrist), palmar thumb, index, middle and radial ring finger, dorsal thumb tip and the dorsal index, middle and radial ring finger distal to the PIP joint (palmar digital branches).
Bone: the phalanges of the thumb, index and middle fingers (indication in the record: volar finger fractures and dislocations). Not shaded: the ulnar third of the palm.
Right hand; one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
